Wait on cooling CHH, Press test CHH to 500 Psi / 10 min; Ok while Make 7 Stds 5" DP stand in mouse hole & R/B same.
Install side outlet vlave on CHH, (2 No. 2-1/16" 5K valve on each side), Set VR Plug, Perform body press test to 4500 Psi / 10 min, Ok. Press test each valves to 4500 Psi / 10 min, OK.

N/U 21-1/4'' 2K x 21-1/4'' 3K DSA (Tie down flange), 21-1/4" 3K Drlg spool, 21-1/4" 3K x 21-1/4'' 2K DSA, 21-1/4'' 2K Diverter & Bell nipple, Tieghten all nuts, work on 4" Choke line & related valves in progress till MN.

(String Wt. in Mud: 300 Klbs @ M/D, String Wt. in Air: 345 Klbs). While pump & hesitate 1 bbl mud in string every 20min (Totally 22 bbl pipe lax pill spot to Ann, EMW: 72.7 pcf). (Totally Pumped 400 bbl 65 pcf waste water, 190 bbl in string & 210 bbl in Ann. EMW: 70pcf, NL-NG).
